label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交改进 json_unpack() 系列在解包失败时的错误信息（在 error 文本中带上出错的 key），改动遍布 pack_unpack.c 的 unpack 路径，正是 json_pack_unpack_fuzzer 调用的接口。接口签名与返回约定不变，harness 只检查返回值、不解析 error 文本：变更前后均可编译，回放语料无新崩溃，新增的错误拼接代码被语料执行到。harness 仍然充分，属于显式 api 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit improves the error message of the json_unpack() family on failure (the offending key is now included in the error text); the changes span the unpack paths of pack_unpack.c, which json_pack_unpack_fuzzer calls. The signature and return conventions are unchanged and the harness only checks return values, never the error text: it builds before and after, replay shows no new crash, and the new error-formatting code is executed by the corpus. The harness stays adequate: explicit api negative.
